target_flow.down: typed CreationPreset/style captured by one CreationSession and one PointerKey
target_flow.move: CreationSession produces per-view transient preview/guide only; canonical generation remains unchanged
target_flow.up: owner-safe-point validates one pending identity and submits exactly one InsertObjects operation
target_flow.cancel: clear session/overlay and submit zero operations
target_flow.publication: host publishes the current preview/guide through the existing per-view transient seam
target_flow.abort: wrong source, stale target, nonfinite or zero extent rejects and clears without mutation
